venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Saturday 3/21.** Busy night. Garden: sunny and well sat early and most of the night; Josh rocked it alone until Kevin came in to barback. D&C: plenty of larger parties, a few close calls on turn times but the room turned fine; non-stop until last call; fun, hectic, fast-paced. Kitchen: busy with many multi-course tables; lots of popcorn. MOD: Cory / Kevin / Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Saturday 3/21.** Perfectly blessed Saturday until a slowdown around midnight; tables ready to refire by 6:30. Guests included boomers who questioned the writer like parents and two ladies squeezing two pregame rounds into 45 minutes. Stef in killer mode at the door; Seth on point. Biggest headwind: lots of high-GCA big checks. Back-catalog banger: Sundial (Singani egg white sour). 9 solos, 5 large parties. Comps $144.94. Kitchen: lots of fries. No door notes. (Report posted ~12:23pm Sunday; form typed 3/21.)
